name: windows
title: Windows
description: Every open window, with its app's icon, most recently used first and grouped by app. Enter switches to it; close, minimise, close or minimise all of the app, and hide or show the app from the action panel.
author: pal

settings.label: Minimised windows
settings.description: Focusing a minimised window restores it.

store.tagline: Every open window, most recently used first; Enter switches to it
features: Live: listed again every time the panel shows, so window titles are root results and the order is most recently used, the window you came from first (macOS and Hyprland)
A section per app; the app name is the subtitle and a keyword, the bundle id or window class a keyword too
A hidden app's window carries a `hidden` tag, a minimised one `minimized`, one on another space `other space` or `ws 3`, and the monitor when known
Close (`cmd+w`) and Minimize (`cmd+m`) keep the palette open and list again; Hide app (`cmd+h`) hides the whole app, Show app (`cmd+shift+h`) brings a hidden one back
Minimize all (`cmd+shift+m`) and Close all (`cmd+shift+w`, asks first) act on every window of the app
Hyprland, Sway and X11 (wmctrl) on Linux, detected rather than configured

screenshots.caption: Open windows in a section per app; a minimised one is tagged
Focus, Close, Minimize, Hide app, and the whole app's windows at once
Window titles and app names are root results: chrome finds its three windows
Close all of this app asks first

actions.title: Focus
actions.description: Hides the panel, then raises the window, restoring it if minimised.

actions.title: Close
actions.description: The palette stays open and lists again.

actions.title: Minimize
actions.description: Not offered on a window that already is.

actions.title: Hide app
actions.description: macOS: hides the window's process through System Events. Not offered on a hidden app.

actions.title: Show app
actions.description: macOS, on a hidden app's window: the app comes forward with every window it had; the panel hides.

actions.title: Minimize all of this app
actions.description: On an app with more than one window.

windows.description: What is open right now, most recently used first.
